children: may extend gains into a range of $102.85-$103.83 per barrel, according to a projection analysis.
The uptrend looks steady. It has extended above a key barrier at $101.26, the 361.8% projection level from $86.22.
The projection analysis suggests a further rise into the $104.44-$105.42 range. Support is at $100.28, a break below which could trigger a fall into the $98.69-$99.30 range.
On the daily chart, the contract is riding on a wave C, which is travelling toward $110.24, its 100% projection level. A wedge indicates a more aggressive target of $117.

The uptrend from $58.72 seems to have resumed, as suggested by the systematic rally from $78.19. However, a confirmed resumption will be when the market breaks the resistance at $104.91, the 61.8% retracement of the downtrend from $126.41 to $70.14.
